composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a lighthouse beam through rolling fog banks, collecting stray radio pings from ships lost in the bay before the signal fades.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each ping reveals a fragment of a ghost transmission
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, wind shear increases, beam narrows
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: charcoal fog with pale amber signal pulses

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick inspection toggles across a miniature floor plan, revealing hidden lens glints before the buyer walks away.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying lens glints popping when you're right
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: blueprint cyan with red lens glints

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw protective buffer zones along a scrolling coastline, blocking illegal construction cranes without touching existing homes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: draw curved exclusion arcs with your finger
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each saved stretch extends the green belt score
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: crane types diversify, tide shifts compress your drawing window

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort incoming agent task cards into parallel lanes—plan, execute, compare, ship—before the sunrise deadline hits.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: combos when you hit the correct workflow order
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: card tempo rises, ambiguous tasks pile up
